description: P3 consumer-assertion + live-constant pin for CHECK 14 (no turn-terminating language in sub-step skill body prose, issue #321). A skill body loads into its CALLING AGENT's context, so caller-scoped terminal prose makes an agent that invokes the skill inline end its turn early and return the skill's output as its own — a silent false PASS. The set_check pins the DETECTION CONSTANTS AS THEY LIVE IN tools/policy_check.sh: it captures the single-quoted RHS body of CHECK14_TERMINAL_REGEX and CHECK14_KEEP_REGEX from the check itself and requires each verbatim (superset), so deleting a terminal alternative, dropping the `^Emit exactly` anchor, or weakening the `stop-and-merge` KEEP phrase fails this fixture. It pins those two live constants only — it does not assert the check's runtime behaviour on any sample body. The consumers pin the load-bearing literals proving the check exists and keeps its contract: the `=== CHECK 14:` section header, `add_finding 'CHECK14'` (it emits CHECK14 findings), the caller-derived discovery that excludes overlord.md, the two position-free discovery constants (Skill-tool marker, token regex assignment), and the three fail-closed findings — empty derived set, marked-but-unresolvable line, and mention/token parity failure.

expected_set: Your final action|final action is a|[Pp]roduce zero (text|chat)|^Emit exactly|and stop
